Compact Groundcar. Upgrades: Armored Chassis, Bulwark Armor, Communications Center, TUp (Flashbulb Beacon) Heavy Chassis, Reinforced Tires, Security Upgrade (Advanced), Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount (w/ Remote Weapon System & United Armaments Modern Assault Weapon). Only runs with a Personal Link plugged in. The driver fires its remote weapon mount with no penalty. An open cockpit: no Climate Control, CrystalDome, Housing Capacity, Optical Camo, Sealed Environment or Seating Upgrade.

Cost: 48,000eb
Nomad: 9 (NCPD)
SDP: 70
SP: 15
MOVE: 10
Speed: 20 mph
